notes.title: Pogger Bots in the latest update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/2cd8e4bebd9f52f90600095b8461a646df89096e.png[/img]

If the bots are no longer challenging you, try to make them faster, more precise, and protect themselves with the shield. The latest BAVR update 2.17.351 has this single new setting, try it! And now you have 4 levels of difficulty that control bots difficulty, let's see how many you can handle at the OP level! The full release notes:

[previewyoutube=OHoeiMERpy0;full][/previewyoutube]

1. Noob, Regular, Pogger, and OP levels of bots change the parameter in lobby settings
2. Teach bots to use the Force Shield, now they can protect themselves too!
3. Update bot's ability to see you in specific cases. Sometimes they can run around without shooting you which is no longer the case.
4. Fix the First Blood voice-over on every game entry.
5. Performance improvements with the latest tooling, packages, and optimizations.

Enjoy and join our Discord:
https://battlearenavr.net/discord

Got a suggestion?
https://battlearenavr.net/feedback

notes.title: 🔫 Dire Blaster, new sky city, and cube maze maps in the BAVR 2.9 release
notes.notes:
In the new release, you've got a new gun - Dire Blaster, a mix of a rocket launcher and a plasma thrower, careful with that. You've also got two new levels: Janus v2, a sky city, and Tarvos v2, a cube maze as well as visual improvements to existing levels. What's new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39015613/fd67b740ca0c0d90770eafe8d036b3ed2ce665fa.png[/img]

1. A new gun - Dire Blaster, a mix of a rocket launcher and a plasma thrower but much stronger and deadlier. It also has a heat-seeking capability!
2. A new level prototype - Janus v2, a sky scrappers city above clouds.
3. A new level prototype - Tarvos v2, a cube maze made of glass and mirrors.
4. Updated horizon (skybox) for Albiorix and Titan maps, new look and feel for old good maps.
5. Fix for tournament games to avoid strangers in your match, and also add additional time if the score is even
6. Even stronger rocket launcher (+50%).

[previewyoutube=YqxQwkthi8E;full][/previewyoutube]
